items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson ruled out with ankle injury.
items.why: Ankle injury during game; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed ruled out.
items.implication: Zero rest of game/week; MIN WR targets redistribute.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off then ruled out with rib strain/injury (was expected to play).
items.why: Carted with ribs; Schefter ruled out, Rapoport rib strain eval tomorrow.
items.implication: Unexpected zero after expected play; SF WR targets open.
items.opportunity: Other SF WRs/TE snap/route increase; reverse prior start confidence.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh/quad injury.
items.why: Thigh injury confirmed OUT by Schefter.
items.implication: Zero production; Jets RB committee or backups elevated.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs Chiefs with knee injury; coach Hafley not optimistic, sounds major concern.
items.why: Knee injury; Rapoport quotes coach major concern.
items.implication: Zero for week; monitor severity for ROS. Handcuff/backup opportunity elevated.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active vs Cowboys after pregame workout looking good; Rapoport notes likely limited usage.
items.why: Pregame workout successful; Schefter confirmed active after team initially not counting on him.
items.implication: Startable but limited snaps/routes expected; late DFS pivot from Bateman/Andrews.
items.opportunity: Primary WR targets if volume holds; reverse prior Bateman/Andrews bumps.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua inactive for SNF vs Broncos.
items.implication: Zero; LAR WR targets to Adams/others.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make 2026 season debut.
items.why: Confirmed active by Schefter/Rapoport; ETR expected.
items.implication: Immediate TE1 upside in debut; high target share expected.

items.text: Jets WR AD Mitchell (finger) inactive/expected inactive; was GTD.
items.why: Schefter/Rapoport inactive; Levitan projected out, confirmed.
items.implication: Targets free up for Jets WRs.
items.opportunity: Garrett Wilson primary; Isaiah Williams/Pritchett/Shepard/McLain + TE Sadiq slot/wide.

items.text: With Mitchell out, Jets WRs: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Jamaal Pritchett 4. Sterling Shepard 5. Malik McLain; expecting TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide decent amount.
items.why: Mitchell inactive confirmed; Levitan depth chart + Sadiq role note for high opp/DFS.
items.implication: Wilson clear alpha; secondary WRs/Sadiq streaming/DFS value.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets spike; Sadiq hybrid usage.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder) expected to play/active vs Chargers (ETR projected limited).
items.why: Schefter expected; Rapoport positive health; Levitan Moore in limited.
items.implication: Viable WR start if limited snaps still produce.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman (foot) expected to play/active vs Bengals.
items.why: Schefter expected; ETR expected to play.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren (shoulder) expected to play/active vs Bengals.
items.why: Schefter expected; ETR listed expected to play; confirmed in actives.
items.implication: Full or near role; startable RB2/flex.

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Matchup smash vs poor rush D; high prop.

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches +15% targets both games, RB7 util; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Berry LOVES Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 YPR to WRs.
Berry HATES Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/g to RBs 3.2 YPC.
items.why: Role shrinkage + tough run D; Henderson 65% snaps post-fumble.

items.text: Berry HATES Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there (RB37 util).
Berry notes Dalton Schultz 28% team target share (30% routes) with Nico Collins out last week; faces IND allowing 4th-most TE yds. LOVES him.
items.why: Elevated target share in Collins absence + matchup.
